title: The digest cover · the bags
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Friday's digest cover, week one: the two bags on Chloe's porch in vertical rain, no people, drawn from the street. The arc's first cover.

panels.composition: A single image: a porch four houses down, two packed bags by the door, rain in frantic vertical hatching, the street empty. Heavy black. No one.

image.prompt: brush-pen over blue pencil, harsh xerox grain, stark black spotting, rain in frantic vertical hatching, a zine cover of two packed bags on the porch of an old wooden house in heavy vertical rain, no people, heavy black spotting, no words
image.notes: Quarter-letter digest cover. Title DRIFT WOOD lettered after. The crab in the margin, facing the bags.

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: Cover, week 1. The bags without her.
